executionPolicy: Never execute formula strings. Implement typed calculations with decimal arithmetic, explicit eligibility and date checks. Reject unsupported situations rather than returning zero. These records verify source rates, not application implementation.

rules.input: Already determined non-negative annual taxable income; age at the end of the tax year. Not gross pay.
rules.calculation: Select highest lower <= income. max(0, base + (income-lower)*rate - applicable cumulative rebates).
limitations: Not a full PAYE withholding implementation
No directives, medical credits, fringe benefits, retirement deductions, irregular pay, annualisation or cumulative reconciliation
No special trusts or non-individual taxpayer treatment

rules.eligibility: Employer confirms employee covered by UIF and provides UIF remuneration, not unclassified gross pay. Exclude employment below 24 hours/month and excluded public-office/government categories.
rules.calculation: For an eligible employee, each share = min(nonnegative monthly UIF remuneration,17712)*0.01; otherwise explicit exempt status with reason.
rules.recipient: SARS or UIF Commissioner according to registration
rules.dueDateRule: 7th of following month; move to preceding business day if weekend/public holiday. Requires verified South African holiday calendar.

rules.eligibility: Expected leviable remuneration in the following 12 months exceeds R500000 and employer is not otherwise exempt. Government, qualifying public entities/PBOs and certified municipalities need separate eligibility assessment.
rules.input: SDL leviable remuneration after applicable allowable deductions and statutory exclusions, independently classified.
rules.dueDateRule: 7th of following month, preceding business day when weekend/public holiday.

rules.effectiveDateMeaning: Publication snapshot, not original commencement of the 15% rate.
rules.eligibility: Registered vendor and supply expressly classified standard-rated. Do not infer registration, zero rating, exemptions or input-tax recovery.
Ordinary company at standard rate; excludes SBC, turnover tax, SEZ and special regimes. Taxable income must already be determined; accounting profit is not automatically taxable income.
rules.calculation: nonnegative verified taxable income*0.27 before applicable credits/payments
